name: After § 50
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Albania
part_text: 50a. Deplores the fact that 23 380 Albanian nationals were recorded as being in an illegal situation within the EU in 2025, according to Eurostat, placing Albania among the top 10 nationalities concerned at EU level; considers this situation to be incompatible with the conditions for a credible accession to the EU;
